messages:
Elliot: Heads-up: eu-west1 rack-7 seeing a bunch of short-lived GPU evictions after last autoscaler refill. Symptoms: Pending pods with InsufficientGPU, lots of preemptions, and ToR NIC TX bursts.
Sun: can you paste node flavors / labels? sounds like mixing again.
Elliot: node list snippet:
```
node-eu7-01  gpu.type=H100_80gb  nvlink=island0  gpu.count=4
node-eu7-02  gpu.type=A100_40gb  nvlink=island1  gpu.count=4
node-eu7-03  gpu.type=H100_80gb  nvlink=island0  gpu.count=2
```
Ravi: ah - mixed H100 + A100 in same rack, different NVLink islands. Scheduler currently packs by free GPU units, not topology. Leaves 1-GPU leftovers on island0 which get backfilled onto island1 -> cross-island memory traffic + NIC burst -> preempt cascade.
Kai: short-term mitigation: label nodes by `gpu_family` and add nodeAffinity for critical inference services to prefer same-family nodes. For batch, create a dedicated low-priority pool.
Elliot: tried that; autoscaler still injects new mixed nodes into the same pool.
Ravi: immediate surgical fix: cordon the mixed nodes and re-provision homogeneous nodes OR taint the new nodes with `gpu_family=H100:NoSchedule` then add tolerations only to the jobs that should run there. That avoids evictions from gentle hints.
Sun: suggestion: we should add a tiny admission webhook that rejects pods with tolerations allowing mixing unless explicitly opted-in. But that's a bit heavy.
Kai: also add telemetry: emit `placement.topology.mismatch` event when scheduler places pods across different nvlink.island values in same pod-level request. We'll graph it vs ToR TX.
autoscaler-bot: Scaling event: added 6 nodes to pool eu-west1-gpu-standard at 09:12 UTC (trigger: spot refill).
Ravi: longer-term: implement a scheduler plugin that scores placements by NVLink island and nvlink-aware co-scheduling. Could be a predicate+score or a custom policy in kube-scheduler. Also add a packing-sim unit test in CI that runs placement with mixed flavors to catch regressions.
Elliot: action items: 1) cordon node-eu7-02..04 (mixed nodes) 2) taint new nodes with `gpu_family` NoSchedule after cordon if still mixing 3) autoscaler PR to respect `pool.homogeneous=true` label 4) RFC for topo-aware scheduler plugin.
Sun: I'll open the autoscaler PR and a short playbook for on-call. Ravi - can you sketch the scheduler RFC?
Ravi: yep, will draft today. I'll include packing-sim harness and metric tags.
Elliot: cordoning now, will monitor for 45m and post status. :mag_right:
